::: {.page-intro}
<p>This is the class's own reaction-time data — one row per trial, the same data used in the Week 1 slides and tools.</p>
<p>
  <button id="w1-download-btn" style="background:#1f7a79;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 24px;font-size:1em;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">
    Download week1_reaction_times.csv
  </button>
</p>
<p id="w1-download-status" style="color:#888;font-size:0.9em;"></p>
<p class="canvas-note">
  If the button doesn't work, right-click and choose "Save Link As…":
  <a id="w1-download-fallback" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stevenolanecon/7002LBSAI/main/data/week1_reaction_times.csv">week1_reaction_times.csv</a>
</p>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var csvUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stevenolanecon/7002LBSAI/main/data/week1_reaction_times.csv";
  var btn = document.getElementById("w1-download-btn");
  var status = document.getElementById("w1-download-status");
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    status.textContent = "Downloading…";
    fetch(csvUrl)
      .then(function (resp) {
        if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
        return resp.blob();
      })
      .then(function (blob) {
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = "week1_reaction_times.csv";
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        status.textContent = "Downloaded — check your Downloads folder.";
      })
      .catch(function () {
        status.textContent = "Something went wrong — use the link below instead.";
      });
  });
})();
</script>
```
